verdict.rationale: Helicone documents first-party self-hosting, including Docker Compose and other deployment methods to run your own instance. That lets a user decide where their logged LLM data lives by choosing their own infrastructure. The evidence never mentions a region or residency selector (e.g. US/EU) for the hosted cloud, and docs note cached responses sit on Cloudflare's global edge network. missing for 10: hosted-cloud region selection (e.g. EU data residency), documented residency guarantees for logs and cache, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency control.
